name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fp8

name: HyperSwap 1a / 1b / 1c (256-px ONNX)
notes: Replaces inswapper_128.onnx; 256px output vs 128px; ~403 MB ONNX each; drop-in via ComfyUI-ReActor; also affects build_faceswap_model and build_video_reactor

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: Drop-in checkpoint for build_sam3_segment/mask/extract and build_magic_eraser; 2-7x faster multi-object tracking via multiplexing; ComfyUI PR #13408 merged; ~6-8 GB VRAM

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
notes: 8.3B vs 13B params; 75% faster; fits 16 GB at FP16; same API surface

name: FLUX.1-dev-ControlNet-Union-Pro-2.0
notes: 3.98 GB vs 6.15 GB; same canny/depth/pose/soft-edge modes; Flux1 Dev only (not Klein); tile mode removed vs v1

name: Ideogram 4.0 (fp8 / nf4)
notes: 9.3B DiT; fp8 fits 16 GB; text-rendering SOTA; JSON structured prompting; day-0 ComfyUI support; NON-COMMERCIAL license requires review before wiring; also relevant to build_lumina2_txt2img

name: SeedVR2 v2 (ICLR 2026 camera-ready)
notes: ICLR 2026 camera-ready paper; adaptive window attention; v2.5 community weights claim 8 GB GGUF + 2-3x speedup; VERIFY weights are live at https://github.com/IceClear/SeedVR2 before wiring; also affects build_seedv2r

name: LTX-2.3 (22B, NVFP4)
notes: 22B params; NVFP4 on RTX 50-series gives 60% VRAM reduction; audio generation; native 9:16; major upgrade over LTX Video 1.x

name: WAN 2.7
notes: 14B MoE; audio conditioning; up to 5 person refs; 1080p; FP8+GGUF offload required on 16 GB (marginal); also affects build_wan22_t2v/flf/blockswap/blockswap_t2v

name: WAN 2.6 Reference-to-Video
notes: New capability: learns motion/camera/style from 1-2 reference clips; VACE-based; same VRAM as WAN 2.2; no current Spellcaster builder equivalent

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution
notes: RTX 5060 Ti Blackwell native Tensor Core upscaling; 30x faster than SW; near-zero VRAM; 4 quality presets; complement to build_wavespeed_upscale and build_upscale

name: FlashVSR v1.1 (CVPR 2026)
notes: One-step diffusion VSR; ~17 FPS @ 768x1408 on A100; Tiny-Long mode fits 16 GB; alternative/complement to SeedVR2

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0
notes: 1536 cubed geometric resolution (3x improvement); 10s mesh on A100; Partner Node install; VRAM for full model unconfirmed — test lightweight variant first; also affects build_hunyuan_3d_textured

name: TRELLIS.2 4B (GGUF/FP8)
notes: Alternative 3D pipeline; full PBR (Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Opacity); GGUF Q4 min 6 GB; ComfyUI-Trellis2 wrapper; credible fallback if Hunyuan3D 3.0 exceeds VRAM

name: facerestore_advanced
notes: Drop-in upgrade to facerestore_cf; adds GPEN 2048, multi-model fallback, SSIM quality assessment; also affects build_photo_restore

name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux2 v0.6.2
notes: Extends PuLID to Klein 4B/9B backbone; native Klein weights (v1 production, v2 experimental); also relevant to build_photobooth

name: ReyChiaro flux.2-klein-controlnet
notes: First Klein-9B native ControlNet (depth/canny/openpose); community-trained; quality audit vs established Flux1 CNs needed; Diffusers-based

name: ComfyUI-RMBG v3.0.0
notes: Adds BEN2, BiRefNet_dynamic, SDMatte, batch support; existing model paths preserved; also affects build_rembg_birefnet

name: ColorMNet (ComfyUI wrapper)
notes: Additive: reference-image-guided colorization using DINOv2; ~700 MB models; distinct from DDColor auto-colorization

name: NormalCrafter (ComfyUI wrapper)
notes: Additive: temporally consistent normal maps for video frames using video diffusion priors; very minimal VRAM requirements claimed

name: Chroma1-Radiance v35
notes: HF last-modified 2026-06-07; Flux-Schnell-based 8.9B, no VAE, Apache 2.0; still actively training — NOT production stable; native ComfyUI v0.3.60 support; revisit at v50+

name: WAN 3.0
notes: 60B total MoE params (14B active); 4K; API access only; open weights expected mid-2026; almost certainly exceeds 16 GB even quantized; do not integrate until weights and VRAM profile confirmed

name: OSDFace (CVPR 2025)
notes: One-step diffusion face restoration; ~0.1s per 512x512; CVPR 2025; no ComfyUI node yet; facerestore_advanced may add support — watch

name: CodeFormer++ (arXiv 2510.04410)
notes: Paper only; weights not publicly confirmed; deformable registration + deep metric learning over CodeFormer; wait for weights

name: BFS Best Face Swap LoRA (Klein 4B)
notes: Klein 4B path recommended for 16 GB; Qwen-2511 (20B) backbone exceeds budget; needs ComfyUI-BFSNodes; quality upgrade for build_klein_headswap; video variant (LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA) created 2026-06-01

name: Wan2.2-VACE video face swap
notes: Video face/character swap via Wan2.2 + Fun-VACE; RTX 5060 Ti confirmed at Q8 GGUF (~7 min per 5-s clip); new capability beyond current ReActor video path

name: LanPaint v1.5.x
notes: Training-free inpainting/outpainting for any backbone (SDXL/Flux/Klein/Qwen); additive to existing Fooocus path; no dedicated checkpoint needed

name: ComfyUI-Flux2Klein-Enhancer
notes: Conditioning enhancement for Klein 9B via Qwen3 8B text encoder tensor manipulation; zero VRAM overhead; improves prompt adherence and concept separation; release date unconfirmed

name: NTIRE 2026 Efficient Super-Resolution winners
notes: 95-team challenge; lightweight efficient SR transformers potentially lighter than SUPIR for upscale-only stages; no packaged ComfyUI node yet; individual team weights TBD

name: Hunyuan3D 2.1 PBR
notes: Full PBR pipeline (diffuse/metallic/roughness/normal); superseded in priority by Hunyuan3D 3.0; evaluate only if 3.0 VRAM exceeds budget

name: SurGe (surface geometry point maps)
notes: Research paper only; no weights or ComfyUI node; Neighborhood Attention Decoder improves 3D reconstruction from monocular input; monitor for weight release

name: HuMo 1.7B (human-centric video+audio)
notes: Unified text+image+audio video gen with lip-sync; 17B full model likely exceeds 16 GB; 1.7B may fit; native ComfyUI support; roadmap item only
